title.narrative: Inclusive Dialogue and women’s political participation

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to engage in inclusive and constructive dialogue with national stakeholders in Commonwealth member countries, with a view to resolving political impasses, achieving consensus on major issues affecting the credibility of elections, and engaging in conflict prevention throughout the electoral cycle and assisting member countries to develop and implement strategies. National stakeholders will be consulted, drawing on good practices, to address the barriers limiting the participation of women in politics and addressing election-based gender violence. This project provides for the delivery of bespoke national programmes to deliver technical assistance, capacity building workshops and other stakeholder engagement as identified in the country strategies. An online Community of Practice platform will be developed for each of the components, to enable member countries to share experiences, expertise and lessons learned with other Commonwealth member countries.
